articles.title: Vaticano divulga primeiras FOTOS de papa Leão XIV após cirurgia | G1
articles.standfirst: Pontífice agradeceu em missa aos profissionais de saúde do hospital Gemelli, em Roma, onde está internado. Leão XIV se recupera de cirurgia de retirada de câncer no pulmão e tem 'melhora contínua' de saúde, disseram os médicos nesta sexta (16).
articles.summary: Pontífice agradeceu em missa aos profissionais de saúde do hospital Gemelli, em Roma, onde está internado. Leão XIV se recupera de cirurgia de retirada de câncer no pulmão e tem 'melhora contínua' de saúde, disseram os médicos nesta sexta (16).
articles.body:
Em imagem divulgada pelo Vaticano, o papa Leão XIV reza missa dentro do hospital Gemelli, em 16 de outubro de 2026. — Foto: Divulgação/ Vaticano

O Vaticano divulgou nesta sexta-feira (16) as primeiras imagens de papa Leão XIV após a cirurgia que ele foi submetido para a retirada de um câncer de pulmão. Veja acima.

As fotos são de uma missa celebrada pelo pontífice às 7h desta sexta, no horário de Brasília, na capela do 10º andar do hospital Gemelli, em Roma , segundo o Vaticano.

"Em sua homilia, o papa agradeceu a todos os funcionários — médicos, enfermeiros e auxiliares — pelo trabalho que realizam diariamente no cuidado dos doentes e de suas fragilidades e, de modo especial, por tudo o que fizeram e continuam fazendo por ele", afirmou o Vaticano em comunicado.

Segundo a Santa Sé, estavam presentes médicos e profissionais de enfermagem do hospital que estavam de folga no momento da missa, além de integrantes do Corpo de Gendarmaria da Cidade do Vaticano.

O papa Leão XIV celebra missa dentro do hospital Gemelli, onde está internado, após a cirurgia para retirada de tumor no pulmão, em 16 de outubro de 2026. — Foto: Vaticano

Pouco antes de divulgar as fotos, o Vaticano atualizou o estado de saúde do pontífice, que apresenta uma "melhora contínua" no seu estado clínico, e anunciou que ele fará oração ao público no domingo (18) da janela do Gemelli e garantiu que a viagem de Leão XIV à América do Sul em novembro continuava de pé até o momento.

➡️ O pontífice, de 71 anos, está internado desde o início da semana, quando foi submetido a uma cirurgia para a retirada de um tumor no pulmão direito, que também foi parcialmente removido. A operação ocorreu após o próprio papa anunciar, no fim de semana, que médicos haviam encontrado um nódulo em seu pulmão.

"Na manhã de hoje, o Santo Padre realizou exames de sangue e uma radiografia de tórax, que confirmaram uma melhora constante em seu estado geral", diz o boletim. "As sessões de fisioterapia respiratória continuaram. Sua recuperação pós-operatória permite, agora, que ele realize suas atividades diárias habituais com total autonomia".

Ainda segundo o Vaticano, o papa Leão XIV retomou na quinta-feira seu trabalho à frente da Igreja Católica e participou de uma missa em uma sala especial no Gemelli.

Papa Leão chega ao Hospital Gemelli antes da cirurgia para remoção de um nódulo pulmonar, em Roma 13 de outubro de 2026 — Foto: REUTERS/Ciro de Luca

Na quarta-feira (14), o Vaticano informou que Leão XIV já havia voltado a se alimentar e caminhava pelos corredores do hospital durante a recuperação. Também na quarta, o papa divulgou uma mensagem na qual agradeceu as orações recebidas de fiéis de todo o mundo e pediu que continuassem rezando por sua recuperação.

"Confiando cada um de vós à proteção da Sagrada Família de Nazaré, peço-vos por favor que rezai por mim, enquanto eu rezo por vós", escreveu na mensagem divulgada na quarta.

A mensagem foi enviada aos participantes de um encontro da Igreja Católica do qual ele não pôde participar por causa da internação. No texto, Leão XIV afirmou que pretende analisar os resultados das discussões e apresentar suas reflexões em momento oportuno.

👉 A cirurgia do papa Leão XIV retirou o lobo inferior do pulmão direito por meio de uma técnica videoassistida. Segundo os médicos, o câncer foi identificado após exames realizados devido a um nódulo detectado anteriormente.

O Vaticano não informou uma previsão de alta, mas tem divulgado atualizações diárias sobre o estado de saúde do pontífice.

O Hospital Gemelli, após o Vaticano ter anunciado que o Papa Leão XIII foi diagnosticado com câncer de pulmão na sequência de uma cirurgia para remover parte do pulmão direito, em Roma. — Foto: Stoyan Nenov / Reuters

articles.title: Debate do 2º turno no Acre será no dia 22 de outubro; veja as regras | G1
articles.standfirst: Encontro entre Alan Rick e Mailza Assis terá quatro blocos, com perguntas entre os candidatos e temas livres e determinados. Transmissão será pela Rede Amazônica e pelo g1.
articles.summary: Encontro entre Alan Rick e Mailza Assis terá quatro blocos, com perguntas entre os candidatos e temas livres e determinados. Transmissão será pela Rede Amazônica e pelo g1.
articles.body:
Rede Amazônica faz reunião para apresentar regras do debate entre os candidatos ao governo do Acre no 2º turno — Foto: Aparecida Cândida/Rede Amazônica

A Rede Amazônica realiza, na próxima quinta-feira (22), o debate entre Mailza Assis (PP) e Alan Rick (Republicanos), candidatos ao governo do Acre no segundo turno das eleições de 2026.

O programa está previsto para começar por volta das 20h30, após a novela Quem Ama Cuida, com transmissão pela TV, pelo g1 e pelo Globoplay. O segundo turno ocorre no dia 25 de outubro.

As regras foram apresentadas em reunião com representantes dos candidatos nesta quinta-feira (15). Apenas a assessoria do candidato Alan Rick (Republicanos) se fez presente.

O debate terá quatro blocos, com perguntas de um candidato para o outro. Serão dois blocos de tema livre, com 26 minutos cada, e dois de tema determinado, com 16 minutos cada.

Neste último formato, os candidatos escolherão entre seis temas definidos pelo jornalismo da emissora, exibidos em um telão.

Cada candidato terá 13 minutos nos blocos de tema livre. Nos blocos de tema determinado, serão dois temas por rodada, com quatro minutos para cada concorrente debater cada assunto.

No último bloco, após as perguntas, os candidatos terão 1 minuto e 30 segundos cada para as considerações finais. A ordem de participação foi definida por sorteio.

Caso um dos candidatos não compareça, a emissora realizará uma entrevista de 20 minutos com aquele que estiver presente, com perguntas sobre os temas previstos para os blocos de tema determinado.

articles.title: Norberto Pinto defende debate plural na Assembleia de Sergipe | G1
articles.standfirst: Em entrevista ao Bom Dia Sergipe, o parlamentar eleito destacou o diálogo e a representatividade de diversos setores como caminho para construção de propostas no estado.
articles.summary: Norberto Pinto destaca diálogo na Alese e aponta causas neurodivergente e do empreendedorismo como prioridades de seu mandato em Sergipe.
articles.body:
Eleito para exercer seu primeiro mandato na Assembleia Legislativa de Sergipe (Alese) a partir de 2027, o deputado estadual eleito Norberto Pinto (Avante) afirmou, em entrevista ao Bom Dia Sergipe, nesta sexta-feira (16), que sua atuação no parlamento será pautada pela construção de um ambiente de debate plural e diversificado. Ele foi eleito com 18.751 votos.

Segundo o parlamentar eleito, a presença de representatividades de diferentes setores da sociedade fortalece os trabalhos e a elaboração de projetos no Poder Legislativo.

"Eu defendo sempre que o ambiente de debate na Assembleia Legislativa precisa ser muito plural. Todas as classes, todos os setores da sociedade, se possível for, serem representados ou terem uma representatividade na Alese. Porque quanto mais o ambiente de debate é plural e diverso, eu entendo que o produto que se constrói ali sai dentro de uma perspectiva de muitos olhares, de uma forma diferente de ver", declarou.

Norberto Pinto defende ambiente de debate plural na Assembleia Legislativa de Sergipe — Foto: Reprodução/ TV Sergipe

Norberto ressaltou ainda que adota um perfil pautado no diálogo e na busca por parcerias com os demais deputados da casa para fazer avançar as pautas de seu mandato.

"Eu tenho um modelo de atuação mais propositivo. Aquela pessoa do diálogo, da construção. Então, nós teremos sim a defesa dessa pauta, mas sempre tentando construir em parceria com os demais colegas", completou.

Como prioridades, Norberto apontou quatro temas que pretende defender durante o mandato.

“Nós temos a causa neurodivergente como prioridade, tendo em vista que nós já desenvolvemos um trabalho, são centenas de famílias que são atendidas de forma gratuita no projeto que nós desenvolvemos. Nós temos o empreendedorismo como uma pauta também muito importante para a nossa atuação. Nós temos compromisso firmado também com o pequeno produtor do sertão, produtor de leite, e também a pauta cristã”, completou.

articles.title: Influenciador vai recorrer de decisão que manda devolver Filó ao Ibama | G1
articles.standfirst: Decisão foi assinada pela juíza Mara Elisa Andrade, da 7ª Vara Federal Ambiental e Agrária. A magistrada negou o pedido de guarda definitiva feito pelo influenciador e determinou que Filó seja entregue ao Centro de Triagem de Animais Silvestres, em Manaus.
articles.summary: O influenciador digital Agenor Bruce Tupinambá afirmou que vai recorrer da decisão da Justiça Federal no Amazonas que determinou a devolução da capivara Filó ao Ibama.
articles.body:
'A gente não vai desistir dessa luta', diz influenciador após Justiça determinar devolução de capivara Filó ao Ibama — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

O influenciador digital Agenor Bruce Tupinambá afirmou que vai recorrer da decisão da Justiça Federal no Amazonas que determinou a devolução da capivara Filó ao Instituto Brasileiro do Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Naturais Renováveis (Ibama). Em publicação nas redes sociais, ele criticou a medida e disse que continuará lutando para permanecer com o animal .

A decisão foi assinada na terça-feira (13) pela juíza Mara Elisa Andrade, da 7ª Vara Federal Ambiental e Agrária. A magistrada negou o pedido de guarda definitiva feito pelo influenciador e determinou que Filó seja entregue ao Centro de Triagem de Animais Silvestres (Cetas) , em Manaus , no prazo de 30 dias após a intimação.

"A gente não vai desistir dessa luta, mais uma batalha que a gente vai enfrentar e vamos recorrer com todos os meios legais para lutar pela Filó", disse o influenciador.

Agenor afirmou que sua equipe de advogados já foi acionada para tentar reverter a decisão. Ele também questionou as condições do Cetas no Amazonas para receber a capivara. "Querem levar ela para o Cetas, como vocês já sabem como é o Cetas do Amazonas, não tem nem condições de ter uma capivara lá. Vão mandar ela para onde? Para um zoológico, para um santuário?", questionou.

O influenciador também defendeu que a presença de Filó na região onde vive contribuiu para a preservação ambiental e o combate à caça ilegal.

"Depois do caso da Filó, ninguém caça mais. Agora, onde a Filó vive é uma área preservada. A Filó tá aí, ela vive solta", declarou.

Pela decisão, após receber o animal, o Ibama deverá iniciar um programa de reabilitação e reintegração de Filó à natureza , preferencialmente em uma área de proteção ambiental adequada à espécie na Amazônia.

Agenor também foi condenado a pagar as custas do processo e os honorários advocatícios da parte vencedora.

O caso começou em abril de 2023, quando o Ibama realizou uma fiscalização na propriedade da família de Agenor, em Autazes , no interior do Amazonas. Na ocasião, o órgão identificou animais silvestres mantidos em convivência doméstica sem autorização ambiental.

A fiscalização resultou em cinco autos de infração, com multas que somaram R$ 17.030 . Entre as irregularidades registradas estavam a exploração da imagem de animais silvestres mantidos irregularmente, o uso de espécies sem autorização e infrações relacionadas à morte de um filhote de preguiça-real.

Dois dias depois, Agenor entrou na Justiça para tentar recuperar o animal. Em 30 de abril daquele ano, uma decisão de urgência concedeu a guarda provisória de Filó ao influenciador , situação que permaneceu até a nova sentença.

Por que a Justiça negou a guarda definitiva?

A juíza considerou que o vínculo afetivo entre Agenor e Filó não é suficiente para justificar a manutenção de um animal silvestre sob guarda particular , sem autorização ambiental.

Na avaliação apresentada na sentença, a legislação brasileira prioriza a devolução de animais silvestres ao habitat natural. A guarda doméstica provisória é considerada uma alternativa excepcional, quando as outras formas de destinação não forem viáveis ou adequadas.

A magistrada também rejeitou o argumento de que Filó deveria permanecer com Agenor por integrar uma família multiespécie, formada por pessoas e animais unidos por vínculos afetivos.

Segundo a decisão, o entendimento jurídico relacionado a animais de companhia não se aplica automaticamente à capivara, que é uma espécie silvestre brasileira.

Ibama aponta necessidade de reintegração à natureza

Outro ponto considerado pela Justiça foi a necessidade de Filó recuperar comportamentos naturais da espécie. A capivara é um animal social, que vive em grupos e desenvolve comportamentos próprios no convívio com outros indivíduos.

O Ibama argumentou no processo que a convivência prolongada com seres humanos poderia aprofundar a domesticação do animal e dificultar uma futura reintegração à natureza.

A sentença também considerou que a permanência de Filó isolada de outras capivaras poderia prejudicar o desenvolvimento de comportamentos naturais. Para a magistrada, a alegação de que o animal não conseguiria retornar ao ambiente natural não foi comprovada por uma tentativa de reabilitação.

A Justiça concluiu que Filó deve retornar ao Cetas para que o órgão ambiental implemente as medidas técnicas necessárias à reabilitação e à reintegração do animal.

Influenciador leva capivara 'Filó' para ser entregue ao Ibama em Manaus. — Foto: Divulgação

A capivara criada pelo influenciador Agenor Tupinambá ganhou repercussão na mídia em fevereiro de 2023 , quando o fazendeiro viralizou nas redes sociais, ao mostrar a rotina com Filó e outros animais silvestres.

Agenor passou a receber apoio de seguidores, personalidades e políticos, incluindo da deputada Joana Darc, que também tem mobilizado as redes sociais em torno do assunto.

Depois da repercussão, o Ibama chegou a se manifestar, na afirmando que " animal silvestre não é pet ".

articles.title: Vacinação antirrábica no Jurunas ocorre neste sábado em Belém | G1
articles.standfirst: Ação será realizada a partir das 8h em dois pontos do bairro; equipes de vigilância também monitoram animais para identificar a circulação do vírus.
articles.summary: A vacinação antirrábica no Jurunas ocorre em dois pontos de Belém após a confirmação de um morcego infectado com o vírus da raiva na região.
articles.body:
Uma ação de vacinação antirrábica será realizada neste sábado (17), a partir das 8h, em dois pontos do bairro do Jurunas, em Belém . A iniciativa ocorre após a confirmação de um caso de raiva em um morcego encontrado na região.

A Secretaria Municipal de Saúde (Sesma) também intensificou as ações de vigilância para prevenir a circulação do vírus.

A vacinação ocorrerá n a Estratégia Saúde da Família (ESF) Portal da Amazônia e no Postão do Jurunas.

Segundo a Sesma, o morcego infectado foi encontrado na Rua dos Tamoios, próximo à Avenida Bernardo Sayão. O animal foi recolhido pela Unidade de Vigilância de Zoonoses (UVZ) em 25 de setembro, e o resultado positivo para o vírus da raiva foi divulgado no início de outubro.

A Sesma realiza capturas e monitoramento de morcegos em diferentes áreas da capital paraense. O trabalho é feito pela Diretoria de Vigilância em Saúde (DVS) e pela Unidade de Vigilância de Zoonoses (UVZ), como parte do Programa de Vigilância da Raiva.

As equipes escolhem locais com vegetação abundante, árvores frutíferas e possíveis abrigos para os animais. As capturas são feitas à noite, com o uso de redes instaladas em pontos estratégicos.

Os morcegos recolhidos são analisados para verificar a possível presença do vírus e identificar precocemente a circulação da doença.

A orientação é evitar o contato direto com morcegos, vivos ou mortos. Caso encontre um animal nessas condições, a população deve acionar os serviços de vigilância responsáveis e não tentar capturá-lo ou manuseá-lo.

A raiva é uma doença viral que pode atingir seres humanos e outros mamíferos. Em caso de mordida, arranhão ou contato da saliva do animal com feridas ou mucosas, é importante lavar o local com água e sabão e procurar imediatamente um serviço de saúde para avaliação.

articles.title: Eleições RN: Propostas de Allyson Bezerra e Cadu para a Saúde | G1
articles.standfirst: Planos de governo dos candidatos ao segundo turno do RN incluem propostas para reduzir filas, regionalizar serviços e fortalecer a rede pública de saúde.
articles.summary: Eleições RN: Allyson Bezerra e Cadu de Lula propõem reduzir filas e regionalizar a saúde pública para fortalecer o atendimento no estado.
articles.body:
Hospital Walfredo Gurgel, em Natal, é a maior unidade hospitalar do Estado — Foto: Thiago César/Inter TV Cabugi

Allyson Bezerra (União Brasil) e Cadu de Lula (PT) disputam o segundo turno da eleição para o governo do Rio Grande do Norte, marcado para 25 de outubro . O g1 analisou os planos de governo apresentados pelos candidatos e reuniu as principais propostas para a saúde .

O plano de Cadu, intitulado RN que Cresce Cuidando de Gente, tem 74 páginas e está dividido em 13 eixos temáticos. A saúde é abordada no eixo 5, “Saúde, Cuidado e Qualidade de Vida”, que reúne diretrizes para ampliar o acesso aos serviços, integrar a rede pública e garantir continuidade no atendimento.

O plano de Allyson tem 44 páginas e reúne 167 propostas distribuídas em 11 capítulos. A saúde é o tema do capítulo 3, que inclui medidas para reduzir filas, fortalecer hospitais regionais, ampliar serviços especializados e melhorar a organização da rede estadual.

Allyson Bezerra (União Brasil) votou em Mossoró — Foto: Iara Nóbrega / Inter TV

O plano do candidato do União Brasil apresenta propostas voltadas à redução do tempo de espera por atendimento e ao fortalecimento da estrutura hospitalar. Entre as medidas estão a ampliação de consultas, exames e cirurgias, a modernização dos hospitais regionais e o reforço de serviços especializados.

O documento também prevê ampliar a oferta de atendimento fora dos principais centros, integrar serviços de urgência e emergência e utilizar tecnologia para melhorar a gestão da rede. Outras propostas tratam da saúde mental, da assistência materno-infantil e da prevenção de doenças.

Redução das filas: estabelecer um programa estadual permanente para reduzir o tempo de espera por consultas, exames e cirurgias, com planejamento contínuo e financiamento previsível.

Fortalecimento da rede regional: ampliar e modernizar hospitais regionais, apoiar consórcios intermunicipais e fortalecer policlínicas e serviços especializados.

Atenção básica e prevenção: cooperar com os municípios para qualificar a atenção básica, ampliar a vacinação e integrar vigilância, laboratórios e resposta a surtos.

Urgência e atendimento materno-infantil: integrar hospitais, SAMU, unidades de pronto atendimento e regulação; fortalecer o pré- natal , o parto seguro e o cuidado neonatal; e implantar gradualmente leitos e referências regionais de UTI pediátrica.

Saúde mental: fortalecer a atenção psicossocial, a prevenção do suicídio, a reabilitação, o cuidado às doenças crônicas e a atenção à pessoa idosa e aos cuidadores.

Gestão e assistência farmacêutica: integrar sistemas de prontuários, regulação, laboratórios, farmácias e gestão hospitalar, além de implantar mecanismos de rastreabilidade de medicamentos e insumos para combater o desabastecimento e o desperdício.

Agenda de Cadu de Lula em 13 de outubro de 2026 — Foto: Inter TV Cabugi

O plano do candidato do PT defende uma rede de saúde mais integrada, com cooperação entre o governo estadual, os municípios e os serviços prestadores. A proposta é organizar o atendimento para que o paciente consiga passar por consultas, exames, diagnóstico, tratamento e reabilitação sem ficar perdido entre diferentes serviços.

O documento também destaca a regionalização da assistência, a prevenção de doenças, a saúde mental e a valorização dos profissionais. A proposta é considerar as necessidades de cada território e acompanhar os resultados do atendimento, com foco na redução das esperas e das desigualdades de acesso.

Redução das filas: organizar a regulação de consultas, exames, cirurgias e tratamentos com critérios de necessidade clínica, risco e vulnerabilidade, além de acompanhar o percurso dos pacientes.

Fortalecimento da rede regional: integrar hospitais, policlínicas, atenção primária, maternidades, serviços especializados e transporte sanitário para aproximar o atendimento da população.

Atenção básica e prevenção: fortalecer a atenção primária, a vacinação, a vigilância em saúde, a saúde bucal e o acompanhamento de pessoas com doenças crônicas.

Urgência e atendimento materno-infantil: integrar os serviços de urgência e emergência e ampliar a articulação entre o atendimento materno-infantil e os demais pontos da rede.

Saúde mental: articular atenção primária, serviços psicossociais, hospitais gerais e apoio às famílias, com ações de prevenção do suicídio e cuidado relacionado ao uso prejudicial de álcool e outras drogas.

Gestão e valorização profissional: investir em formação permanente, condições de trabalho, financiamento, assistência farmacêutica e integração de informações para melhorar a gestão do SUS.

articles.title: Zelensky pede R$ 400 bilhões à UE em meio a tensões com Trump | G1
articles.standfirst: Pouco antes, líderes europeus reafirmaram seu apoio à Ucrânia na guerra contra a Rússia, e criticaram os EUA pela flexibilização de sanções contra Moscou.
articles.summary: Pouco antes, líderes europeus reafirmaram seu apoio à Ucrânia na guerra contra a Rússia, e criticaram os EUA pela flexibilização de sanções contra Moscou.
articles.body:
Vladimir Putin, Donald Trump e Volodymyr Zelensky. — Foto: Sputnik/Gavriil Grigorov/Pool via REUTERS, Reuters e Genya Savilov/AFP

O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelensky , pediu aos líderes da União Europeia que forneçam um financiamento adicional de 70 bilhões de euros - o equivalente a R$ 400 bilhões - para a Ucrânia no próximo ano, para ajudar o país a continuar lutando contra a Rússia, , nesta sexta-feira (16).

Em discurso na cúpula do bloco em Bruxelas, após a UE reafirmar seu apoio à Ucrânia na guerra contra a Rússia, Zelensky fez o apelo, que classificou como um "valor realista":

"A guerra custará 155 bilhões de euros no próximo ano. E precisamos de pelo menos mais 70 bilhões de euros de vocês — para defesa, armamento e para nossa resiliência. Este é um valor realista. E peço que encontrem esse apoio".

Os líderes europeus expressaram seu apoio a Kiev ao comentar o momento de grande tensão entre Zelensky e o presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump , e diante da preocupação de que Washington se aproxime cada vez mais das posições da Rússia.

As relações entre Ucrânia e Estados Unidos ficaram ainda mais tensas desde a semana passada, quando Trump flexibilizou as sanções contra a Rússia em troca do fornecimento, por parte de Moscou, de grandes quantidades de diesel aos mercados mundiais e ao mercado americano .

Zelensky chamou o acordo de "indigno" e afirmou que servirá apenas para encorajar a Rússia a prosseguir com a guerra contra a Ucrânia, iniciada em fevereiro de 2022.

Vários aliados europeus de Kiev também criticaram o acordo, que pretende aliviar os preços dos combustíveis nos Estados Unidos a poucas semanas das eleições de meio de mandato de 3 de novembro.

A situação se agravou depois que Zelensky ordenou a retomada dos ataques ucranianos contra refinarias russas, ignorando as exigências de Washington.

A crise tem outro ponto de tensão: as interrupções de um sistema de satélites fornecido pelos Estados Unidos, que dificultaram a capacidade de resposta das Forças Armadas ucranianas aos bombardeios russos.

Trump e Zelensky se encontram na Casa Branca, em 18 de agosto de 2025 — Foto: Kevin Lamarque/Reuters

"Não é o momento de retirar nosso apoio à Ucrânia. Não é o momento de aliviar as sanções contra a Rússia", declarou o presidente do Conselho Europeu, António Costa, ao receber Zelensky em Bruxelas para uma reunião de cúpula da União Europeia.

O mandatário ucraniano agradeceu o apoio daqueles que chamou de "verdadeiros líderes" europeus e afirmou que não há sinais de que Moscou esteja disposto "a acabar com esta guerra".

Por sua vez, o primeiro-ministro dos Países Baixos, Rob Jetten, advertiu que "a situação na Ucrânia é atualmente muito grave", devido aos vários ataques russos e ao agravamento da relação com os Estados Unidos.

"É fundamental que hoje, como Europa, demonstremos nosso apoio incondicional à Ucrânia e examinemos que medidas adicionais podemos adotar", afirmou.

Zelensky precisa administrar uma relação de altos e baixos com Trump desde que o imprevisível presidente americano voltou ao poder, em janeiro do ano passado, com a promessa de reduzir o apoio de Washington a Kiev.

Na quinta-feira, Trump considerou "uma vergonha" que a Ucrânia retomasse os ataques contra refinarias russas e afirmou que Kiev estava contribuindo para o aumento dos preços mundiais da energia.

"Acho que considero mais difícil lidar com Zelensky do que com Putin", declarou o presidente americano em uma entrevista ao canal Newsmax.

Por sua vez, o Kremlin acusou a Ucrânia de dificultar os "intensos esforços" de paz dos Estados Unidos ao retomar os ataques contra as refinarias.

Grande parte da indignação na Ucrânia nesta semana concentrou-se nas restrições ao sistema de comunicações por satélite Starshield, do qual as Forças Armadas dependem para detectar ataques russos e coordenar a resposta na linha de frente.

Este sistema da empresa SpaceX é diferente do Starlink, a rede civil de satélites que a Ucrânia também utiliza, embora não para operações de ataque.

O magnata do setor de tecnologia Elon Musk afirmou que sua empresa não estava por trás de nenhuma interrupção do Starshield.

"Os sistemas Starshield pertencem ao governo dos Estados Unidos e estão sob seu controle. Qualquer limitação de largura de banda ou de uso é decidida pelas Forças Armadas americanas e, em última instância, pelo presidente dos Estados Unidos", disse.

A chefe da diplomacia da UE, Kaja Kallas, destacou que "o Starlink é realmente necessário para a Ucrânia" e admitiu que "a Europa não consegue substituir este sistema a curto prazo".

Embora a prioridade dos líderes europeus seja superar a crise com Washington, eles também pretendem debater maneiras de reforçar as defesas aéreas da Ucrânia e como enfrentar sua delicada situação orçamentária.

"Temos que nos preparar para o inverno. Não se trata apenas de energia, mas também de defesa antiaérea e de financiamento", declarou Zelensky.

Os dirigentes da UE discutirão como manter o apoio à Ucrânia no próximo ano. A União Europeia conta atualmente com um programa de empréstimos de 90 bilhões de euros (516 bilhões de reais) destinado a Kiev, criado para cobrir as necessidades financeiras até o final de 2027.

As autoridades ucranianas, no entanto, advertiram que precisarão de dezenas de bilhões de euros adicionais, já que os ataques russos atingiram duramente a economia do país.

O debate sobre novas ajudas provocou a retomada dos apelos para que a UE utilize quase 200 bilhões de euros (1,14 trilhão de reais) em ativos congelados do Banco Central russo no financiamento da Ucrânia.

No momento, parece haver pouco impulso político para avançar nesta direção, devido à oposição da Bélgica, onde está depositada a maior parte dos fundos congelados.

articles.title: ‘Sonhava com a formatura’, diz tia de jovem que morreu em acidente | G1
articles.standfirst: Phâmella Cristina Hilbert, de 25 anos, deixou dois filhos. Ela sofreu acidente de trânsito em Araguaína, norte do estado.
articles.summary: Phâmella Cristina Hilbert, de 25 anos, deixou dois filhos. Ela sofreu acidente de trânsito em Araguaína, norte do estado.
articles.body:
Phâmella Cristina Jardim da Silva Hilbert, de 25 anos — Foto: Divulgação/Redes Sociais

A estudante Phâmella Cristina Jardim da Silva Hilbert , de 25 anos, se formaria em Estética e Cosmética no primeiro semestre de 2027. A jovem, que morreu em acidente de moto em Araguaína , sonhava com a conclusão do curso.

"Ela sonhava com formatura para atuar na área, gostava muito de estética. Fascinada com cada aprendizado. Cada dia mais contente", afirmou a tia Val Mesquita.

O acidente aconteceu na madrugada desta quinta-feira (15). Segundo a Secretaria da Segurança Pública (SSP), a jovem teria perdido o controle do veículo e bateu em um poste, no bairro Cidade Nova.

Equipes do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) realizaram manobras de reanimação, mas Phâmella não resistiu e morreu no local. O caso segue sendo investigado pela 29ª Delegacia de Polícia Civil de Araguaína.

A jovem trabalhava em uma clínica feminina de ultrassonografia e ginecologia em Araguaína. Em nota de pesar, a Clínica Femina lamentou a morte e ressaltou que o exemplo de carinho e dedicação deixado por Phâmella irá acompanhar a equipe.

Phâmella havia completado 25 anos no dia 20 de setembro. Ela deixa dois filhos, um de 5 anos e outro de 3 anos.

articles.title: BR-343: DNIT suspende pare e siga entre Teresina e Altos | G1
articles.standfirst: Serviços de instalação de dois bueiros foram concluídos antes do prazo, e a circulação de veículos voltou ao normal no trecho.
articles.summary: A BR-343 entre Teresina e Altos teve o tráfego liberado após o DNIT antecipar o fim das obras e suspender a operação pare e siga devido aos intensos congestionamentos.
articles.body:
Congestionamento na BR-343 — Foto: Reprodução

O Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura de Transportes (DNIT) suspendeu por tempo indeterminado a operação de pare e siga na BR-343, entre Teresina e Altos , após o registro de congestionamentos intensos.

A operação começou na terça-feira (13). Segundo o DNIT, o controle do tráfego era necessário para a implantação de bueiros nas obras de duplicação da rodovia.

Imagens registradas na quarta-feira (14) e enviadas à Rede Clube mostram o sistema de pare e siga em funcionamento e longas filas de veículos no trecho. Nas imagens, motoristas aguardam a liberação do tráfego.

O DNIT informou que os serviços de implantação de dois bueiros, previstos inicialmente para serem concluídos na sexta-feira (16), foram finalizados na tarde de quinta-feira (15). Com isso, o tráfego foi totalmente liberado no trecho.

Ao todo, as obras preveem a implantação de 35 bueiros. O órgão informou ainda que avalia alternativas para executar os serviços sem a necessidade desse tipo de controle do tráfego.

O Departamento Nacional de Infraestrutura de Transportes no Estado do Piauí (DNIT/PI) informa que a operação do sistema de Pare e Siga na BR-343/PI, entre Teresina e Altos, está suspensa por tempo indeterminado, enquanto o órgão avalia alternativas para a execução dos serviços sem a necessidade desse tipo de controle de tráfego.

A decisão foi tomada diante das dificuldades registradas no cumprimento da sinalização pelos condutores e do intenso fluxo de veículos na rodovia, fatores que comprometem a operação e a segurança no local. Nesta quinta-feira (15), por volta das 16h, foram finalizados os serviços de implantação de dois bueiros, inicialmente previstos para sexta-feira (16).

Com isso, o tráfego foi totalmente liberado no trecho. O DNIT/PI comunicará oportunamente novas definições sobre a execução dos serviços e eventuais alterações no tráfego.

*Juliana Cristina, estagiária sob supervisão de Carlienne Carpaso.

articles.title: Quem era Aliton Alves, jornalista mineiro e ex-assessor do Tupi  | G1
articles.standfirst: Despedida do jornalista e ex-assessor do Tupi acontece nesta sexta-feira (16), de 9h às 15h, no Crematório Candelária, em Matias Barbosa.
articles.summary: Ele morreu na quinta-feira (13), aos 63 anos. Despedida acontece nesta sexta-feira (16), de 9h às 15h, no Crematório Candelária, em Matias Barbosa.
articles.body:
Morreu na quinta-feira (15), em Juiz de Fora, o jornalista Ailton Alves Pereira, 63 anos. O velório acontece nesta sexta-feira (16), das 9h às 15h , no Crematório Candelária, localizado na Estrada União Indústria, Km 6, em Matias Barbosa. A cremação será às 15h .

Formado pela Universidade Federal de Juiz de Fora (UFJF) em 1992, Ailton atuou em diversos veículos da imprensa local, com foco nas coberturas política, cultural e esportiva. Natural de Galileia, no interior de Minas Gerais, ele iniciou a carreira no Diário Regional , em 1994, onde atuou como repórter de política, região e assuntos especiais, foi editor e cronista esportivo.

Ainda na década de 1990, foi noticiarista na Rádio Manchester. Em 2000, tornou-se editor-chefe, crítico de cinema e cronista esportivo do Jornal dos Sports . Também participou do programa Mesa de Debates, na TVE de Juiz de Fora, e atuou nas editorias de esportes e política do jornal Tribuna de Minas .

Em 2003, publicou o livro “Meus sonhos são bastante razoáveis” e, em 2004, “A Saga dos Carijós” , que reúne suas crônicas sobre o Tupi . Em 2007, recebeu a Medalha do Mérito Legislativo da Câmara Municipal de Juiz de Fora. Ailton também ocupou o cargo de chefe de Imprensa na Prefeitura da cidade.

articles.title: PM vows to intervene on Essex school 'sibling ban' row
articles.summary: A family with a disabled child say a "sibling ban" prevents them attending milestone events.
articles.body:
The prime minister has promised to intervene on a school's "sibling ban" rule that prevents a family with a severely disabled child attending milestone events.

Natasha and James say their six-year-old daughter, Hollie, who attends Benyon Primary in South Ockendon, Essex, is often left in tears as they cannot attend plays and parents' evenings.

Hollie's three-year-old brother William has profound, life-limiting disabilities. He needs 24/7 care, making childcare harder to find.

The Catalyst Academies Trust, which runs the school, denies a ban. But, like many schools, limits some events to parents only for "practical and safety reasons".

Since the school's rule change last September, William's parents say they have missed parents' evenings, singing events, progress meetings, phonics lessons, special assemblies and school plays.

Natasha, 40, was a nursery nurse until William's birth, when she became his full-time carer.

His dad James is a regional sales manager and is often away with work, leaving Natasha unable to attend events because she has no one to leave him with.

She said Hollie often "ends up sitting crying in the crowd because she can't see her mum or her dad in the audience", adding: "That breaks my heart."

Jen Craft, Labour MP for Thurrock, raised the family's story at Prime Minister's Questions on Wednesday, and told the BBC that the trust had done little to respond to her concerns.

"William is a delightful little boy. As they cannot bring William or leave him with a babysitter this effectively means that Hollie's parents also stay away from school events."

She said the trust had "repeatedly refused to make an exception.. or meet with myself to discuss ways forward".

Prime Minister Andy Burnham replied that he had asked the Department for Education to speak to the trust "to resolve this situation without delay".

Craft told the BBC the trust "made me want to tear my hair out," adding: "They were completely unreceptive to me from day one.

"For me it is a lack of compassion and a lack of seeing how they can best support disabled families."

The family has recently acquired nine hours of respite a week through Thurrock Council.

Natasha says this is vital for her, as William is "restless" in the night and she does not sleep, but often the support does not coincide with school events.

Tony Parfett, the trust chief executive, said: "For some events we need to control the number of attendees for practical and safety reasons. There is no ban on siblings attending these kinds of events."

He said WiIliam's parents "brought their son to a parent-only event in September 2025 and were advised that attendance was limited to two parents per pupil.

"They had the option of one parent staying with their son while the other attended the event but instead chose to leave. This September, one parent attended the same parent-only event."

He offered to speak to the family "to seek further arrangements that can be made to assist their attendance at scheduled events while remaining fair to all parents".

articles.title: Car registered to man accused of planning mass shooting was at Hindu temple he targeted, police say
articles.summary: Illinois authorities believe a 19-year-old man charged with planning a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in suburban Chicago entered the building’s parking lot on Sunday, hours before police arrested him near his home after receiving a tip about the alleged attack plan.
articles.body: CHICAGO — Illinois authorities believe a 19-year-old man charged with planning a mass shooting at a Hindu temple in suburban Chicago entered the building’s parking lot on Sunday, hours before police arrested him near his home after receiving a tip about the alleged attack plan. Authorities announced Wednesday that they had arrested Alexandros Paporakis and provided the additional detail about his suspected movement during a news conference Thursday. The leaders of Sri Venkateswara Swami (Balaji) Temple in a statement said a security threat had “targeted our Temple” and announced an increased security presence. Palatine Police Chief William Nord said a red Acura RDX registered to Paporakis entered a temple parking lot on Sunday around 12:25 p.m. and left less than 15 minutes later. He was seen alone inside the car around 2 p.m. near his home in another suburb. Paporakis faces felony charges of making a terrorist threat and unlawfully possessing a rifle. Prosecutors have said his co-workers at a Taco Bell location called 911 after Paporakis told them he “couldn’t wait to kill Indian people” and said Sunday would be the “special day.” Temple adds security after threat Sri Venkateswara Swami (Balaji) Temple in Aurora, around 40 miles west of downtown Chicago, said leaders were in contact with police. “Please know that the safety of our devotees, employees and volunteers is our highest priority, and we have implemented additional security measures effective immediately, including increased armed security presence at the Temple,” a statement said. Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi, who represents Illinois’ 8th congressional district, said he was at the Hindu temple on Sunday. “I visited not knowing that there was an attacker lying in wait with a sinister motive to commit a mass shooting, and only because his AR-15 weapon jammed was he not able to commit a massacre that day,” Krishnamoorthi told The Associated Press on Thursday. Krishnamoorthi said he had increased his security in response to the alleged planned attack. He called on the FBI to “investigate and prosecute this particular matter as a hate crime,” and the Trump administration to release federal nonprofit security grants to bolster security at religious institutions. “People are really shaken up,” he added. Aurora Mayor John Laesch said at a Thursday news conference at the Council on American Islamic Relations’ Chicago office that police were “made aware” of other scheduled celebrations and are reaching out to other temples in the area “to make sure that they know they have a number to call.” Court records detail the accused attacker’s words Paporakis told a coworker on Sunday afternoon that his gun jammed and he left quickly, but promised to “retry,” according to prosecutors. He sent the coworker a video showing an AR-style rifle and a photo of himself wearing a tactical vest, they added. Paporakis also sent the coworker an eight-page document in which he used racial slurs to describe non-white people and outlined a plot to kill as many of them as possible, according to prosecutors. He also described himself as a white supremacist and a neo Nazi who fantasized about mass murder. Police arrested Paporakis later that day near his home in Palatine, which is located about 40 miles (64.37 kilometers) northeast of the temple. Detectives who searched his home found an AR-style rifle without a serial number, loaded magazines and “hundreds of rounds” of ammunition, a gas canister labeled with a slur referring to South Asians, a tactical vest and a patch depicting Nazi symbolism, authorities say. Paporakis’ mother was questioned, but she is not cooperating with the investigation, police said on Thursday. At a Wednesday court appearance, a judge ordered Paporakis to remain in detention. His next court hearing is scheduled for Oct. 30. “This case is in the earliest stage of what will likely be a lengthy process,” the office of the Cook County Public Defender, which is representing Paporakis, said in a statement emailed to the AP. “We would remind the public that statements made by police and prosecutors are only allegations and that cases can change significantly as they continue to be investigated.” The targeting of the Hindu temple is another example of heightened threats in the last few years against South Asians in the U.S., according to Stop AAPI Hate, the national reporting center for anti-Asian hate incidents. Online slurs and threats have risen significantly, co-founder Manjusha Kulkarni said in a statement. “We are grateful this violent plot was thwarted and that no one was hurt – but it doesn’t erase the fear Hindu, Indian, and South Asian people feel after years of escalating hate,” Kulkarni said. “Violence against South Asian people is not inevitable. It is fueled when leaders stoke fear of immigrants and people of color for political gain.” She attributed some of the anti-South Asian sentiment to the Trump administration’s rhetoric around Indian immigrants who hold work visas. She also pointed to a Texas Republican last month posting a social media video of South Asian students cheering at a University of Texas football game and referring to them as “foreigners.” The temple, like other Hindu temples and households around the country, has been celebrating Navratri, a Hindu festival that lasts nine days. It “should be a time for celebration and unity, not terror and hate,” Kulkarni said.

articles.title: A Maine couple grew their own wedding flowers in a 30-by-50-foot backyard garden after estimating florist costs could reach $5,000
articles.summary: Mariah Reading and David Mainero decided to grow their own wedding flowers after learning that a single bridal bouquet would cost $400.
articles.body: Mariah Reading and David Mainero decided to grow their own wedding flowers after learning that a single bridal bouquet would cost $400. The couple planted a 30-by-50-foot garden in Reading’s parents’ backyard in Hampden, Maine, in May 2026, hoping to avoid spending thousands of dollars on flowers for their September wedding.According to The PEOPLE, the garden had five long rows of blooms, including dahlias and amaranth, which they planned to use for bouquets, boutonnieres, and other arrangements. The project cost about $1,000 and required months of care, research, and patience. By their wedding on September 26, the flowers had become an important part of the celebration, giving the couple a personal way to prepare for their marriage.How a couple saved thousands by growing their own wedding flowersReading began exploring options for a wildflower-style bridal bouquet and was quoted $400 for the bouquet alone. As the couple was also saving to buy a house in the area, she estimated that wedding flowers could cost between $3,000 and $5,000, leading them to grow their own instead.Reading and Mainero created a garden in her parents’ backyard. The project cost about $1,000, including a rented rototiller, loam soil, seafood compost, locally ordered seeds and chicken wire to keep deer and other animals away.Reading began planting in mid-May, several months before their September 26 wedding. The couple wanted flowers that suited their colourful, relaxed celebration without spending thousands on professionally arranged blooms.How the couple chose their wedding flowers and learned to grow themReading wanted the flowers to reflect the transition between summer and autumn. Her chosen colours included vermilion, bright red, orange, lilac, soft purple, green and chartreuse. Amaranth provided long, dangling shapes, while dahlias added deep maroon, plum and magenta tones.The wedding theme was vibrant, whimsical and fun, and the garden was planned around that vision. However, Reading had never grown a full-scale flower garden before. Although her parents had grown plants when she was growing up, cultivating flowers on this scale was completely new to her.She sought advice from a gardening friend, researched how to grow the plants, and learned to accept that not everything would go according to plan. Some flowers failed to grow as expected, while the white gladiolas bloomed and finished before the wedding.How homegrown flowers and creative exchanges shaped their weddingReading and Mainero spent the summer tending the flowers, learning about gardening and adjusting to the changing seasons and weather. Reading said, “I just think growing your own flowers is so rewarding on multiple levels, and I think a lot of people kind of were picking up on the metaphor of tending to your relationship and adding water and providing for it and giving it sunlight.”The garden also allowed the couple to make other parts of their wedding personal. Reading’s college friend hand-sewed her wedding dress, and Reading made a landscape painting in return. Her sister-in-law prepared a buttercream amaretto cake with strawberry rhubarb filling and decorated it with flowers from the garden, according to The PEOPLE.Reading also exchanged painting lessons for two full days of photography. Friends and family helped with other details, while the couple reused and sourced items rather than buying everything new. Their wedding arch was built from wooden boat components found through Facebook Marketplace.Why growing their own flowers made the wedding more personalOn the morning of their wedding, Reading went into the garden to pick her own bouquet, while Mainero selected his boutonniere. Reading described the moment as especially meaningful and one she expected to remember forever.The couple’s approximately 40 guests also experienced the garden, with some picking flowers during the celebration. After the ceremony, Reading and Mainero took a canoe ride, returning to an activity connected to their first date. They had met while working as park rangers at Isle Royale National Park in Michigan, and their first date had been a canoe trip.Reading said the garden helped the couple build a closer connection with the flowers used in their wedding. articles.title: China tells Israel to stop 'forced establishment' of West Bank settlements
articles.summary: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi spoke to Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of a conference.
articles.body:
Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi has told Israel to stop its "forced establishment" of settlements in the West Bank and reverse its actions, his office said.

The "Palestinian question" is "the greatest historical injustice of this century", Wang told Israeli President Isaac Herzog in a face-to-face meeting on the sidelines of a conference in Azerbaijan on Thursday.

Beijing has been a longstanding supporter of the Palestinian cause and has maintained that a "two-state solution" is the "correct direction".

It has also been positioning itself as a mediator for conflicts in the Middle East.

In 2023 Beijing brokered a deal to restore diplomatic ties between Iran and Saudi Arabia after years of hostility. Earlier this year, it was part of efforts, along with Pakistan, to propose a ceasefire in the US-Israel war against Iran .

Beijing's efforts to tackle the war in Gaza have focused on Palestinian unity.

In 2024 Beijing got rival Palestinian factions to agree to form an interim "national reconciliation government" for the occupied West Bank and Gaza after the war with Israel, although it was never implemented.

Now, Wang says the "immediate priority" is to fully open access to Gaza and stop the continued spread of a "humanitarian catastrophe".

China is willing to work with the international community to get the parties to return to dialogue and "seek a political solution to the conflict", Wang said.

In a post on X, Herzog said he was "pleased" to meet Wang and their talk "focused on the relations between our countries and the situation in the Middle East".

"I emphasised Israel's desire for peace in the region, alongside the strategic threats to our security, first and foremost from Iran and its terror proxies," he wrote.

China maintains close ties with Iran and is the biggest buyer of Iranian oil, which had previously come under US sanctions because of Tehran's nuclear programme.

One year into the ceasefire, people in Gaza continue to live under the regular threat of Israeli strikes, displacement and food security challenges.

Although large-scale bombardment has stopped, Israel has continued strikes in Gaza almost every day . More than 1,400 Palestinians have been killed in Israeli strikes there in the year since the ceasefire started in October 2025.

The US-brokered ceasefire was the first phase of a deal to end the war in Gaza, which had been triggered by a deadly Hamas-led attack on Israel on 7 October 2023.

But progress into the deal's next phase has been stalled, with both Israel and Hamas accusing each other of violating the terms of their agreement.

articles.title: Tesla's 'flying car' Roadster stuns in demo: How high can it fly and what will it cost?
articles.summary: Tesla's long-delayed next-generation Roadster has taken centre stage after a demonstration featuring mid-air manoeuvres, rocket-style thrusters and a
articles.body: Tesla's long-delayed next-generation Roadster has taken centre stage after a demonstration featuring mid-air manoeuvres, rocket-style thrusters and a landing on its wheels, raising questions about whether flying cars could become a reality. Unveiled by Elon Musk's electric vehicle company at an event in Texas on October 15, the redesigned sports car was developed in collaboration with SpaceX, Musk's rocket company. Tesla says production is expected to begin in 2028, nearly a decade after the vehicle was first revealed.The demonstration showed the two-seater Roadster driving upside down along a ramp with the help of a suction system before lifting off, rotating in mid-air and landing. It also performed a manoeuvre in which it jumped over other Tesla vehicles. However, the demonstration does not establish that the Roadster can fly like an aircraft or function as a conventional flying car.Despite the dramatic display, several practical questions remain unanswered, including the vehicle's maximum flight altitude, the distance it can cover in the air, the final production specifications and its confirmed selling price.How high did Tesla Roadster fly, and how far did it travel?Tesla has not publicly confirmed the maximum altitude or horizontal distance covered by the Roadster during the demonstration. The footage showed the vehicle briefly lifting off the ground, rotating in mid-air and returning to the surface, as well as using its thrusters to jump over other vehicles. The demonstration established that the prototype could perform short airborne manoeuvres, but it did not establish the car's ability to sustain flight over long distances.The distinction is important because a vehicle that briefly leaves the ground is not necessarily capable of functioning as a flying car for everyday transportation. Sustained flight would require further information about its lift, stability, flight duration, energy consumption, control systems and safety performance. Tesla has not published independently verified figures for these capabilities.Sharing footage of the demonstration, Tesla wrote, "Real life, baby". Musk also said: "Turns out the future does have flying cars."How does Tesla's flying Roadster work?The Roadster combines electric vehicle technology with a system developed in collaboration with SpaceX. Its demonstration featured two main technologies: a suction system that allows the car to travel upside down along a specially designed ramp, and cold-gas thrusters that help it lift off, rotate and stabilise itself during brief airborne manoeuvres.Tesla has described the suction mechanism as a multi-mode fan and ground-sealing system that draws air from beneath the vehicle, generating downforce. This is intended to keep the car pressed against a surface even when it is upside down. Active aerodynamics and adjustable suspension are also part of the vehicle's performance-focused design.The cold-gas thrusters use pressurised gas to generate thrust, with actuators controlling their operation. Unlike a conventional car, which relies on tyre grip for acceleration and cornering, the thruster-equipped version is designed to generate additional force for specialised manoeuvres.Tesla said on X: "Every car on the road today is limited by one thing: tire grip Roadster's thruster system generates 4–5x the force the tires can. More force on the same mass means significantly better acceleration – physics does the rest,"Tesla added: "Roadster is a true pilot's car: active aerodynamics, a multi-mode suction system & cold-gas thrusters."These are company claims and have not been independently verified through publicly available performance testing. The demonstration also does not establish how the system would perform under normal road conditions or in adverse weather.What is the Tesla Roadster's top speed and acceleration?The Roadster's headline performance claim is acceleration from zero to 60 miles per hour (around 97 kmph) in less than one second. Tesla also says the car can exceed 230 mph (around 370 kmph). These figures were presented at the unveiling and should be treated as manufacturer claims rather than independently verified production-car performance.The acceleration target would place the Roadster among the most extreme performance vehicles if achieved in a production model. However, its claimed airborne capabilities are separate from its road performance. Tesla has not provided independently verified figures establishing how much the thruster system improves acceleration, how frequently it can be activated or how it affects the vehicle's range.The company has also not established that every version of the Roadster will offer the same capabilities.What is the price of Tesla's flying Roadster?Tesla has not announced a confirmed final purchase price for the redesigned Roadster. When the second-generation model was first unveiled in 2017, the company quoted a starting price of $200,000, but that figure has not been confirmed as the price of the latest version.Tesla's reservation page following the unveiling listed different deposits for different versions:Performance: A $50,000 reservation deposit.Thrust: A $250,000 reservation deposit for the version featuring acceleration thrusters.Rocket: An invitation-only variant described as having a full flight system.These amounts are reservation deposits, not confirmed final selling prices. The Rocket version is described as a single-seat vehicle, while the other configurations have different specifications. The full-flight variant is not approved for public-road use, according to reporting by The Information.The final cost could vary depending on the version, equipment and production specifications. Prospective buyers should therefore not interpret the original $200,000 estimate or the reservation deposits as confirmed prices for the redesigned car.When will Tesla Roadster production begin?Tesla has set 2028 as its target for beginning production of the redesigned Roadster. The timeline follows years of delays after the company first unveiled the next-generation model in 2017 and initially promised deliveries in 2020.The original Roadster, produced from 2008 to 2012, was Tesla's first electric vehicle and was built using a Lotus Elise chassis. The new model is intended to serve as a high-performance flagship, showcasing the company's engineering capabilities as Tesla expands its focus towards autonomous driving, artificial intelligence and robotics.Can Tesla's flying Roadster be used on public roads?The Roadster's demonstration does not mean that its airborne functions are ready for unrestricted public use. Tesla's different configurations have different stated capabilities, and the full-flight Rocket version is described as not approved for public-road use.Regulatory approval, safety standards and the practical requirements of operating a vehicle capable of leaving the ground remain key questions. A car that uses thrusters to lift off or rotate in mid-air would need to demonstrate that these operations can be carried out safely and predictably, particularly around pedestrians, other vehicles and buildings.There are also questions about how the system would affect occupants, how the vehicle would respond to a mechanical or propulsion failure, and where airborne manoeuvres could legally be performed. Tesla has yet to provide sufficient public information to establish that the Roadster can be used as a conventional flying car.For now, the unveiling demonstrates a prototype capable of brief airborne manoeuvres, not a vehicle proven to replace aircraft or routinely fly between destinations. Its maximum flight height, distance, endurance and final price remain unconfirmed.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: Stanhope Street: Homes evacuated after Belfast house explosion
articles.summary: Nicola Nugent and her children escaped injury after their house in north Belfast was targeted.
articles.body:
A mother of four whose north Belfast home was pipe-bombed has said the attack was a case of mistaken identity.

Nicola Nugent said the device was put through the letterbox of her home on Stanhope Street at about 03:00 BST on Friday.

Police said it "exploded fully", setting off the fire alarm and causing damage to the front door and the hallway.

Nugent and her four children escaped from their home and no-one was injured.

Det Sgt Stevenson, from the Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI), said: "We are thankful that they escaped injury, though they are obviously very shaken by their ordeal."

Cordons have now been lifted and residents are able to return to their homes.

Homes in Stanhope Street have been evacuated, with police cordons in place as Army bomb experts carry out an investigation.

Nugent said: "I was just woke up with an explosion at just after three o'clock. [I] jumped up, trying to get the kids out.

"There was so much smoke so we couldn't really see what they were doing."

Nugent said she "definitely, 100%" believed it was a case of mistaken identity.

She said she was still in shock and did not want to think about what could have happened.

Sinn Féin assembly member Carál Ní Chuilín condemned the attack and said the family were "very, very lucky".

"She has four children, the youngest of which is a baby of a year old," said Ní Chuilín.

"As far as I'm concerned, this was attempt of murder."

Police have appealed for anyone with information to get in touch.

articles.title: Police officer who raped two women jailed for 12 years
articles.summary: Campbell Petrie was found guilty of physical and sexual abuse towards the women between 2006 and 2023.
articles.body:
A former police sergeant who was found guilty of a catalogue of sex crimes, including raping two women, has been jailed for 12 years.

Campbell Petrie had been convicted of eight charges involving physical and sexual abuse towards the women in Glasgow over a 17-year period between 2006 and 2023.

Petrie, who had denied the allegations, will be supervised and monitored in the community for a further three years after his release.

He is one of four serving or former Police Scotland officers who have been exposed as rapists in the space of five months.

It has also emerged that 45 serving officers are currently suspended over allegations of violence against women and girls.

Petrie was first arrested in 2009 after one of his victims accused him of threatening behaviour.

He was held in a police station for five hours, but no further action was taken at the time because of a lack of evidence.

In 2023, a second woman accused him of rape, prompting an investigation by specialist sexual crime officers.

Petrie was arrested, charged and suspended in December 2023. He retired from the force two years later.

In September this year he was found guilty at the High Court in Glasgow of eight charges involving sexual and physical assaults against the two women, including four counts of rape.

Judge Alistair Watson said he was imposing a sentence which reflected the seriousness and persistence of Petrie's crimes.

"I have read the eloquent and moving descriptions provided by both of the women and they describe the trauma at your hands, and the nature of the psychological harm that affects them today," he said.

The judge said the women had shown "remarkable courage" during the court proceedings.

"It was obvious that they suffer enduring pain for what you did to them," he told Petrie.

"I hope the resolution of these proceedings may close a chapter on their lives and allows them to move on with the process of recovery."

He placed Petrie on the sex offenders register and said he posed a risk of "significant harm to the public, particularly women you come into contact with in future".

The judge also imposed indefinite non-harassment orders which prohibit Petrie from contacting his victims in any way, and ordered him to stay 100m away from any location he believes his victims may be.

Petrie made no reaction when he was led from the dock by guards.

Assistant Chief Constable Tim Mairs said Petrie had committed "a series of severely abusive, exploitative and violent crimes towards women.

"His offending is in stark contrast to the professionalism and commitment of the officers who investigated him and ultimately helped bring him to justice."

Mairs said Petrie's victims had shown great courage in reporting his crimes and that he hoped the sentence would bring them some "closure and comfort".

He added: "This investigation shows the public that when matters of this nature are reported to us, regardless of who the perpetrator is, victims will be listened to and supported as we take immediate action to identify, investigate and bring to justice those responsible."

Petrie was sentenced the day after serving police officer John Williamson was found guilty of raping a teenage girl and a woman in Shetland . He will be sentenced in December.

In July, former constable Cameron Ross was jailed for 10 years for raping two women and abusing a third.

And in May, Alan Greer took his own life just days after a police raid on his home as part of an investigation into offences dating back to 2012.

An investigation has since established that the officer was a violent serial sex offender with at least 15 victims .

Petrie's conviction raised fresh questions over background checks on police in Scotland.

In 2023, all UK forces carried out a "historic data wash" following the crimes of Met officers Wayne Couzens, who abducted and murdered Sarah Everard, and serial rapist David Carrick.

Officers and staff were checked against the national police data base to identify whether they had a criminal past which had been missed.

Police Scotland has said that the 2023 data wash had not identified any unknown information on Petrie.

Earlier this month the force's commanding officer, Chief Constable Jo Farrell, told BBC Scotland News that 45 serving officers were currently suspended over allegations of violence against women and girls .

Under new regulations brought into force this year, about 8,000 police officers and staff will undergo renewed vetting.

The process is prioritising long-serving officers and those who work closely with vulnerable people.

articles.title: Yorkshire Wildlife Park reopens after man killed by tiger
articles.summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park says the decision was made after 'engagement with the relevant authorities'.
articles.body:
Yorkshire Wildlife Park has reopened for the first time since a man was killed by a tiger in an enclosure.

William Chapman, 24, was mauled to death at the park near Doncaster on Saturday. The public were evacuated after the incident with the attraction closed since then.

An inquest that opened into Chapman's death on Thursday heard of his history of mental illness and a diagnosis of schizophrenia. His family expressed concerns about his contact with mental health services leading up to his death.

City of Doncaster Council, which is responsible for licensing the park, is carrying out a health and safety investigation and said it would share the outcome with the coroner, the inquest was told.

Yorkshire Wildlife Park confirmed on Thursday it would reopen following "engagement with the relevant authorities".

In a previous statement on social media, the park said "many, many people" had contacted it about Altai, the Amur tiger involved in the incident, and it confirmed he was "safe and well" and would not be euthanised.

A spokesperson said its "Land of the Tiger" area, where Saturday's incident took place in front of staff and members of the public, was also open.

Several hundred cars could be seen at the popular attraction on Friday morning, with many young families and wildlife enthusiasts carrying cameras heading in.

Among them was Taylor, who was visiting with her partner and their two children, aged one and three, for the youngest child's birthday.

She said: "We just want to support the centre, it's just very sad and we feel for staff who must have been through a lot.

"We will go to the tiger enclosure and feel safe."

Glyn, an animal enthusiast, was "glad to be coming" and also remarked on the "sad incident".

He said he never "felt unsafe" at the park, adding that the animals were "secure".

A park statement said Altai's "ongoing welfare at YWP remains a priority of our experienced animal care team".

The statement went on to say: "We continue to assist South Yorkshire Police and other relevant agencies with their ongoing inquiries into the circumstances of this tragic incident.

"As we welcome visitors back, we would ask everyone to be understanding and respectful towards our staff team, who have shown tremendous professionalism and dedication during an exceptionally difficult time.

"We are providing specialist trauma support and ongoing care for those affected.

"As inquiries remain ongoing, it would be inappropriate for us to comment further on circumstances at this time.

"We would like to thank everyone for their patience, understanding and support during this difficult period, and we look forward to welcoming visitors back to the park."

Chapman's inquest at Doncaster Coroner's Court was told he had suffered previous bouts of psychosis.

The self-employed online trader was born in Chichester, West Sussex, and living in Doncaster at the time of his death.

He had been under the care of the Rotherham, Doncaster and South Humber NHS Trust but was "highly functioning and independent with no care requirements", the inquest heard.

A trust spokesperson said it had launched an investigation after Chapman's death but would not comment further due to patient confidentiality.

The inquest was adjourned until 18 March 2027.

articles.title: Trump says Ukraine resuming strikes on Russian oil sites is a ‘disgrace’
articles.summary: President Donald Trump has labeled Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace,” the latest salvo in his campaign to pressure the U.S. ally over rising gas prices that could cost Republicans in next month’s midterm elections.
articles.body: President Donald Trump has labeled Ukraine’s resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries a “disgrace,” the latest salvo in his campaign to pressure the U.S. ally over rising gas prices that could cost Republicans in next month’s midterm elections. Kyiv said Thursday that it would no longer abide by Trump’s “energy ceasefire,” citing Russia’s refusal to halt its own attacks on Ukraine’s power grid. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy angrily accused the U.S. of costing civilian lives by striking deals with Moscow and withdrawing support that is crucial to Kyiv’s defense against the invasion launched by President Vladimir Putin. Ukrainian officials had raised alarm after gaps in intelligence sharing left Kyiv vulnerable to Russian attacks and restrictions on the Starlink satellite service disrupted military operations. Zelenskyy said Friday that the technology was still not fully restored. With Ukraine defying his demands to halt strikes, Trump responded late Thursday. “If you tell me that Zelenskyy is again shooting at refineries, all he’s doing is making the world oil price higher,” Trump told Newsmax’s Rob Finnerty. “I think that’s a disgrace. There’s plenty of other targets; they don’t have to hit,” Trump said. “Zelenskyy is not a good guy for us to deal with” on the war, he said, adding that “I think they actually both would like to see it end, but I think I find Zelenskyy to be more difficult to deal with than Putin.” As his clash escalated with Trump, Zelenskyy was in Brussels on Friday to shore up support from European allies, whom he called “real leaders” as they gathered for a crucial summit. Ukraine hit a Russian oil refinery Thursday after Zelenskyy said he was “done” with the truce, which Trump had announced to the apparent surprise of both sides in the war. Neither Moscow nor Kyiv reported any new strikes on Russian refineries Friday. Trump has sought to blame Ukraine’s strikes for destabilizing the price of diesel globally, despite the impact of his own war with Iran. But this campaign of attacks deep inside enemy territory has given Ukraine crucial leverage, sparking a major fuel crisis inside Russia. Kyiv hoped this would give it a stronger hand at the negotiating table, but as Washington pushes for an end to the conflict it has taken a series of steps that have caused surprise and alarm among Ukraine and its backers in Europe. Last week, Trump announced a deal to buy diesel from Russia, an apparent attempt to relieve pressure at the pump for American consumers ahead of the midterm elections but which reversed years of U.S. policy. Trump then called for Kyiv to stop all strikes on Russian oil infrastructure and said Zelenskyy had to be replaced as Ukraine’s leader. It comes amid mounting questions about whether the U.S. is still sharing critical military intelligence with Ukraine after a pair of major strikes earlier this week that Kyiv said came without a usual advance warning from its partners. Ukraine also reported a slowing down of the Starlink satellite terminals, which are critical for its army’s communications, drone missions and aerial defenses. Kyiv said that Starshield, the military version of the technology that is used by Ukraine’s troops, had been limited without any warning. SpaceX chief Elon Musk, the billionaire Trump ally, said that such decisions were up to the U.S. military and ultimately Trump. After repeated requests for comment about Musk’s statement, a senior U.S. official told NBC News that “no such request was ever made by the president.” Trump has also denied restricting military intelligence for Ukraine. Kyiv said Thursday the Starshield service was being restored, but the episode only added to the mounting suspicion in Ukraine that the U.S. was willing to cut it off from battlefield support in order to exert pressure for a peace deal. Asked about the service on Friday, Zelenskyy said that issues were ongoing. “Has the speed been fully restored to what it was? No. Is the speed returning? Yes,” he told reporters in Brussels. European and Ukrainian officials told NBC News they believed that the moves, coming only days after Trump eased sanctions on Russia’s diesel exports and railed against Zelenskyy, were most likely aimed at pressuring Kyiv into making concessions at the negotiating table amid the stalemate in peace talks. The Kremlin agreed with Trump on Friday, with spokesman Dmitry Peskov saying it was clear that “Zelenskyy doesn’t want to take responsibility and move toward a peaceful resolution.” Russia has always stated it’s open to a peace settlement but only on its own hard-line terms, which would see Ukraine ceding significant territory.

articles.title: Amazon opens new £107m Peterborough distribution centre
articles.summary: The site is the largest distribution centre of its kind in Europe and could create up to 1,400 jobs.
articles.body:
Online retail giant Amazon has opened a new £107m distribution centre in Peterborough, which is set to create 1,400 jobs in the city.

The building, on Flaxley Road, is next to an existing site the company runs, which opened in 2010. It currently employs more than 1,000 members of staff.

The 690,000 sq ft site is part of the company's £40bn UK investment plan for 2025-27 and is expected to ship up to five million items a week.

Tomislav Batinic, Amazon's site leader, said: "This site is a complete reinvention of how we run part of our logistics operation, and a historic moment for Amazon. It is the first of its kind in the UK and the largest in Europe."

Nothing is shipped directly to customers from the new centre.

Instead, it holds products customers buy most often, such as household essentials like pet food and toilet paper, and feeds them out to about 20 fulfilment centres across the country, where they are combined with the rest of a customer's order for delivery.

It is the first of Amazon's One Distribution Centres in the UK, aimed at reducing "processing steps" and speeding up deliveries.

It has capacity to store 16 million items at peak, which the company said was roughly twice that of other sites.
